have h_div : 18 ∣ 3740 + n := by rw [← h₁]
  have h_mod : (3740 + n) % 18 = 0 := Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr h_div
  have h_mod_calc : 3740 % 18 = 14 := by
    have h₁ : 3740 = 18 * 207 + 14 := by
      rw [← Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_add_mod]
      suffices : 3740 = 18 * 207 + 14 by rw [this]
      rw [Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_add_mod]
      exact Nat.mul_add_mod 18 207 14
    rw [h₁, Nat.mod_add_mod]
  rw [h_mod, h_mod_calc, Nat.mod_add_mod] at h_mod
  have h_n_mod : n % 18 = 4 := by
    rw [h_mod, Nat.mod_add_mod]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_eq_add_mul h_mod_calc
  have h_n_lt : n < 18 := by
    linarith [h₀, Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h₀ (by norm_num : 9 < 18))]
  have h_n : n = 4 := by
    have : n % 18 = n := by
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h_n_lt]
    rw [this, h_n_mod]
  exact h_n

have h_sum : a + b + c = 7 := by
    have h₃ := h₀ + h₁ + h₂
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm, add_assoc] at h₃
    simp [add_mul, mul_add, add_assoc, add_comm] at h₃
    have : 7 * (a + b + c) = 34 := by ring
    rw [this] at h₃
    simp [add_mul, mul_add, add_assoc, add_comm] at h₃
    linarith [h₃]

  have h₄ : 2 * (a + b + c) = 14 := by
    rw [h_sum]
    ring

  have h₅ : 2 * a + 2 * b + 2 * c = 14 := by
    rw [h₄]
    ring

  have h₆ : a + b + c = 7 := h_sum

  have h₇ : a = 7 - b - c := by
    rw [h₆]
    ring

  have h₈ : 3 * a + b + c = -3 := h₀
  rw [h₇] at h₈
  simp at h₈
  have h₉ : 21 - 3 * b - 3 * c + b + c = -3 := by rw [h₈]; ring
  have h₁₀ : 21 - 2 * b - 2 * c = -3 := by rw [h₉]; ring
  have h₁₁ : 2 * b + 2 * c = 24 := by rw [h₁₀]; ring
  have h₁₂ : b + c = 12 := by rw [mul_eq_mul_left_iff]; linarith [h₁₁]

  have h₁₃ : a + 3 * b + c = 9 := h₁
  rw [h₇] at h₁₃
  simp at h₁₃
  have h₁₄ : 7 - b - c + 3 * b + c = 9 := by rw [h₁₃]; ring
  have h₁₅ : 7 + 2 * b = 9 := by rw [h₁₄]; ring
  have h₁₆ : 2 * b = 2 := by rw [h₁₅]; ring
  have h₁₇ : b = 1 := by rw [mul_eq_mul_left_iff]; linarith [h₁₆]

  have h₁₈ : a + b + 3 * c = 19 := h₂
  rw [h₇] at h₁₈
  simp at h₁₈
  have h₁₉ : 7 - b - c + b + 3 * c = 19 := by rw [h₁₈]; ring
  have h₂₀ : 7 + 2 * c = 19 := by rw [h₁₉]; ring
  have h₂₁ : 2 * c = 12 := by rw [h₂₀]; ring
  have h₂₂ : c = 6 := by rw [mul_eq_mul_left_iff]; linarith [h₂₁]

  have h₂₃ : a = 7 - b - c := h₇
  rw [h₁₇, h₂₂] at h₂₃
  simp at h₂₃
  have h₂₄ : a = -1 := by rw [h₂₃]; ring

  have h₂₅ : a * b * c = -1 * 1 * 6 := by rw [h₂₄, h₁₇, h₂₂]; ring
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_comm] at h₂₅
  simp at h₂₅
  ring
